texts.facts: The said Notification dated 12.01.2021 was issued by the State Government in exercise of power of Regulation 2.3.4 of said 2011 Regulations and Section 26 of said 2006 Act. Since the State Government did not implement the said Notification dated 12.01.2021, the petitioners have preferred this writ petition. From the perusal of the impugned Notification dated 12.01.2021 it is seen that it was only for a period of 1 (one) year from the date of its issuance, i.e. upto 11.01.2022 and as such the said Notification dated 12.01.2021 spent its force.
